title: Frontend actions
description: Server actions (save, delete), the form schema and the delete confirmation of a resource.

name.description: Resource name, singular or plural (e.g. invoice).

app.description: Frontend app the pages go into (apps/<app>).

lib.description: Frontend lib (packages/frontend/<lib>, created if missing) the code goes into; the route pages stay in the app. Without it: where the resource already is, else the app.
